Submission deadline: 18 October 2026

Number of scholarships: 1

To promote research on issues relating to consumer rights and the promotion of sustainable consumption, the Association of Consumers of the Italian-speaking Switzerland - ACSI is establishing an annual award open to all USI graduates of the Master’s programmes in the Faculty of Communication, Culture and Society of USI who have written their Master’s thesis on topics consistent with the Association’s statutory aims. Theses will therefore be considered if they aim to:

  • raise awareness, inform and educate consumers so that they can make informed and responsible choices;
  • defend consumers’ interests;
  • pursue objectives in line with the principles of sustainable development.

The deadline for submitting theses is 18 October 2026. Further details can be found in the call for applications.
